name: Poise Payroll
description_en:
Poise Payroll is an India-focused HR and payroll product from Maruti Computers, with cloud, licensed-software and full-service outsourcing options. Public features cover employee history, salary formulas, leave, loans, statutory reports, self-service and optional biometric/mobile capabilities.

The commercial options should be evaluated separately: a cloud software subscription is not the same as an outsourced payroll and filing service. The License card does not disclose an amount or enough deployment detail to establish a self-hosted installation or source-code rights.
description_zh:
Poise Payroll 是 Maruti Computers 面向印度的 HR 与工资产品，提供云端、软件许可及全服务外包选项。公开功能涵盖员工历史、工资公式、休假、借款、法定报表、自助，以及可选生物识别和移动能力。

商务选项需分别评估：云软件订阅不等于工资及申报外包。License 卡未公布金额或足够部署细节，不能确立自托管安装或源代码权利。

core_features.explanation_en: The feature page describes salary, tax and reimbursement formulas, employee history and configurable department/grade/deduction categories.
core_features.explanation_zh: 功能页描述工资、税及报销公式、员工历史和可配置部门、职级、扣款类别。

core_features.explanation_en: Track leave allocation, approvals and encashment; final settlement includes salary, loans, leave and statutory components.
core_features.explanation_zh: 跟踪休假分配、批准及折现，离职结算涵盖工资、借款、休假及法定组成。

core_features.explanation_en: The software describes TDS/Form16/PT and other reports, while Full Service separately offers payroll, registration and online filing.
core_features.explanation_zh: 软件描述 TDS、Form16、PT 等报告，Full Service 单独提供工资、登记及在线申报。

pricing.summary_en: Cloud ₹1,975/month up to 50 +₹39/additional employee. Full Service ₹125/employee/month; License unpriced, optional modules and tax need quote. Free cloud offer is 30-day trial.
pricing.summary_zh: 云端最多 50 人每月 1,975 卢比，超额每人 39。全服务每人每月 125，License 无金额，可选模块及税需询价。云免费仅为 30 天试用。

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from the attached primary sources. Vendor documentation does not establish independent testing or customer outcomes.
Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.title_en: Configure categories and formulas before payroll
sections.title_zh: 处理工资前配置类别与公式
sections.en: Poise describes employee categories such as departments, grades and designations, plus salary, loan, leave, tax and reimbursement definitions. Its Personnel Information System maintains employment history; reports can be filtered by pay month, department and designation and exported in common office formats. A useful pilot would reconcile one salary, one allowance, one loan recovery and one approved absence against the current payroll source. The page’s broad automation and accuracy claims do not independently validate the formulas or a particular employer’s statutory setup.
sections.zh: Poise 描述部门、职级、职位等员工类别及工资、借款、休假、税和报销定义，人员信息系统保存任职历史，报表可按工资月份、部门和职位筛选并导出常见办公格式。试运行可把一项工资、津贴、借款回收和已批准缺勤与现行来源核对。页面广泛的自动化及准确声明，不能独立验证公式或特定雇主法定设置。

sections.title_zh: 核对考勤、申报资料及结算
sections.en: The feature page describes biometric IN/OUT punches, hours, lateness, early departures and overtime; mobile features include location attendance, payslips and leave requests. The price card marks biometric integration, self-service and the mobile app as optional on paid offerings, so do not assume every subscription includes them. The documented TDS declaration workflow downloads an Excel sheet for completion and upload. For an exit case, check final salary, outstanding loan, leave encashment and gratuity under approved rules, then inspect the report and payment responsibility. Neither “any biometric device” nor statutory correctness was tested.
sections.zh: 功能页描述生物识别上下班、工时、迟到、早退和加班，移动能力含位置考勤、工资单及休假。付费价目将生物识别、自助和移动应用标为可选，不能假定各订阅均含。TDS 资料流程明确为下载 Excel、填写并上传。离职场景需按认可规则核对最终工资、未还借款、休假折现和离职金，再检查报告及付款责任。未测试“任何生物识别设备”或法定正确性。

sections.title_en: Separate cloud subscription, license and outsourcing
sections.title_zh: 区分云订阅、许可与外包
sections.en: The cloud card lists ₹1,975 monthly for up to 50 employees plus ₹39 monthly for each additional employee. A stable 60-person team would therefore have a published software base of ₹2,365 monthly before optional modules, taxes or other quoted services. The free card is explicitly a 30-day cloud trial. The License card contains no price, while Full Service lists ₹125 per employee per month for outsourcing and associated software functions. Confirm minimums, employee counting, setup, filing scope, optional modules and payment responsibilities instead of treating ₹125 as the cloud fee or the license as free. The outsourcing page directs buyers to request a quote.
sections.zh: 云卡列出最多 50 人每月 1,975 卢比，超额每人每月 39。固定 60 人团队按公布软件基础公式为每月 2,365 卢比，尚未计可选模块、税和其他服务。免费卡明确是 30 天云试用；License 卡没有价格；Full Service 则以每员工每月 125 卢比提供外包及相关软件。需确认最低账单、人数计数、设置、申报范围、可选模块及付款责任，不能把 125 当云费或把许可当免费。外包页引导取得报价。

sections.title_en: Assign the operator and the service responsibilities
sections.title_zh: 明确操作人与服务责任
sections.en: The outsourcing page describes provider setup, payroll inputs, tax calculations, reports and statutory remittance support, with actual fund disbursement dependent on the company arrangement. Prepare employee history, balances, salary formulas, location rules and approvers, and agree who supplies changes, reviews payroll and responds to notices. Poise may fit Indian payroll teams or employers choosing supported outsourcing; a buyer seeking documented global payroll or a confirmed self-hosted edition needs further evidence. Live workflows, device compatibility, APIs, hosting, security controls, exports, recovery, signed terms and source licensing remain unverified. No payroll or filing was executed.
sections.zh: 外包页描述供应商设置、工资输入、税计算、报表和法定缴款支持，实际资金发放取决于企业安排。需准备历史、余额、薪资公式、地区规则和审批人，并约定谁提供变更、复核工资和回复通知。印度工资团队或选择支持外包的雇主可评估 Poise，需要有文档的全球工资或已确认自托管版本的买家则需更多证据。实际流程、设备、API、托管、安全、导出、恢复、合同和源代码许可未核实，未执行工资或申报。
